Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 198311 Act Number: 11 Enactment Date: 1983-08-25 Act Year: 1983 Short Title: The Telangana Lokayukta Act, 1983. Long Title: An Act to make provision for the appointment and functions of Lokayukta and Upa-Lokayukta for the investigation of Administrative action taken by or on behalf of the Government of Telangana or certain Local and Public Authorities in the State of Telangana (including any omission and commission in connection with or arising out of such action) in certain cases and for matters connected therewith.
